```plato
//==
// # Curves
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Curves — derived functions for the curve interfaces
//  - The angular-curve bridges
//  - Derived functions for the curve capability interfaces
//  - Discretizing curves and surfaces

library Curves
{
    //==
    // # Curves — derived functions for the curve interfaces
    //
    // Bodies for ICurve1D / ICurve2D / ICurve3D and the two closed-curve markers
    // declared in `curves.concepts.plato`. Every function's first parameter is
    // interface-typed, so each helper becomes available on every implementing type.
    // Endpoints, chords, secants, and finite-difference estimates are all derivable
    // from `Eval` alone; nothing here needs a member the interface does not already
    // declare.
    //
    // The canonical parameter domain of a curve is the unit interval [0,1], and
    // evaluation goes through the `Eval` member inherited from `IProcedural`.

    //==
    // # ICurve1D
    //
    // A real function of one real parameter (IProcedural<Number, Number>).
    // Evaluated over the canonical [0,1] domain; endpoints and central-difference
    // estimates of the slope are the derivable conveniences.

    // The value for a parameter; an intent-revealing alias for Eval.
    ValueAt(self: ICurve1D, t: Number): Number
        => self.Eval(t);

    // The value at the start of the canonical domain, Eval(0).
    StartValue(self: ICurve1D): Number
        => self.Eval(0.0);

    // The value at the midpoint of the canonical domain, Eval(0.5).
    MidValue(self: ICurve1D): Number
        => self.Eval(0.5);

    // The value at the end of the canonical domain, Eval(1).
    EndValue(self: ICurve1D): Number
        => self.Eval(1.0);

    // The signed change in value across the whole domain, Eval(1) - Eval(0).
    TotalRise(self: ICurve1D): Number
        => self.Eval(1.0) - self.Eval(0.0);

    // The mean of the two endpoint values.
    AverageEndpointValue(self: ICurve1D): Number
        => self.Eval(0.0).MidPoint(self.Eval(1.0));

    // A central-difference estimate of the first derivative at t using step h.
    // Precondition: h > 0 and t +/- h stay in the domain of interest.
    SlopeAt(self: ICurve1D, t: Number, h: Number): Number
        => (self.Eval(t + h) - self.Eval(t - h)) / (2.0 * h);

    // A central-difference estimate of the second derivative at t using step h
    // (divides by h squared). Precondition: h > 0 and h chosen so t +/- h stays
    // within the domain of interest.
    SecondDerivativeAt(self: ICurve1D, t: Number, h: Number): Number
        => (self.Eval(t + h) - 2.0 * self.Eval(t) + self.Eval(t - h)) / (h * h);

    //==
    // # ICurve2D
    //
    // A continuous map from a parameter to a plane position
    // (IProcedural<Number, Point2D>). Endpoints, the chord, and secant sampling
    // are derivable from Eval alone.

    // The position for a parameter; an intent-revealing alias for Eval.
    PointAt(self: ICurve2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => self.Eval(t);

    // The curve's starting position, Eval(0).
    StartPoint(self: ICurve2D): Point2D
        => self.Eval(0.0);

    // The position at the middle of the domain, Eval(0.5).
    MidPoint(self: ICurve2D): Point2D
        => self.Eval(0.5);

    // The curve's ending position, Eval(1).
    EndPoint(self: ICurve2D): Point2D
        => self.Eval(1.0);

    // The straight-line vector from the start to the end of the curve.
    Chord(self: ICurve2D): Vector2D
        => self.Eval(0.0).Between(self.Eval(1.0));

    // The straight-line distance from the start to the end of the curve.
    ChordLength(self: ICurve2D): Number
        => self.Eval(0.0).Between(self.Eval(1.0)).Magnitude;

    // The secant vector between the positions at parameters t0 and t1.
    SecantBetween(self: ICurve2D, t0: Number, t1: Number): Vector2D
        => self.Eval(t0).Between(self.Eval(t1));

    // A finite-difference velocity estimate at t using step h: the secant over
    // [t - h, t + h] divided by its width. Precondition: h > 0 and h chosen so
    // t +/- h stays within the domain of interest.
    VelocityAt(self: ICurve2D, t: Number, h: Number): Vector2D
        => self.Eval(t - h).Between(self.Eval(t + h)) / (2.0 * h);

    //==
    // # ICurve3D
    //
    // A continuous map from a parameter to a space position
    // (IProcedural<Number, Point3D>).

    // The position for a parameter; an intent-revealing alias for Eval.
    PointAt(self: ICurve3D, t: Number): Point3D
        => self.Eval(t);

    // The curve's starting position, Eval(0).
    StartPoint(self: ICurve3D): Point3D
        => self.Eval(0.0);

    // The position at the middle of the domain, Eval(0.5).
    MidPoint(self: ICurve3D): Point3D
        => self.Eval(0.5);

    // The curve's ending position, Eval(1).
    EndPoint(self: ICurve3D): Point3D
        => self.Eval(1.0);

    // The straight-line vector from the start to the end of the curve.
    Chord(self: ICurve3D): Vector3D
        => self.Eval(0.0).Between(self.Eval(1.0));

    // The straight-line distance from the start to the end of the curve.
    ChordLength(self: ICurve3D): Number
        => self.Eval(0.0).Between(self.Eval(1.0)).Magnitude;

    // The secant vector between the positions at parameters t0 and t1.
    SecantBetween(self: ICurve3D, t0: Number, t1: Number): Vector3D
        => self.Eval(t0).Between(self.Eval(t1));

    // A finite-difference velocity estimate at t using step h. Precondition:
    // h > 0 and h chosen so t +/- h stays within the domain of interest.
    VelocityAt(self: ICurve3D, t: Number, h: Number): Vector3D
        => self.Eval(t - h).Between(self.Eval(t + h)) / (2.0 * h);

    //==
    // # IClosedCurve2D
    //
    // A 2D curve satisfying Eval(0) = Eval(1). The residual gap between the two
    // endpoints witnesses how well an implementation honours that guarantee.

    // The distance between the first and last evaluated points; zero for an
    // exactly closed curve.
    ClosureGap(self: IClosedCurve2D): Number
        => self.ChordLength;

    // True when the endpoints coincide within the given (non-negative) tolerance.
    IsProperlyClosed(self: IClosedCurve2D, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.ClosureGap <= tolerance;
```
